headline: Brazil maintains green energy tariff flag for electricity consumers in November
summary: Brazil's electricity regulator Aneel maintained the green tariff flag for November, meaning consumers will face no additional charges on power bills for the second consecutive month.
why: Energy tariff flag mechanisms in Brazil dictate household electricity billing surcharges based on hydroelectric generation capacity and thermal power costs.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Absence of tariff surcharges keeps household energy costs stable, subduing inflationary pressures.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
